item.subject: Advanced Mathematics
item.stem:
A radio-active element decomposes according to the formula,

y = y_o e^(-kt)

where y is the mass of the element remaining after t days and y_o is the value of y for t = 0.

Find the value of the constant k for an element whose half-life (i.e. time to decompose half of the material) is 4 days.

reference_items.subject: Advanced Mathematics
reference_items.stem:
For what real value of k will the equation below describe a circle with radius 3?

x^2 + y^2 + 2x - 4y + k = 0

Show all your work.

descriptors:
K = -4. Method used:
• Because of the quadratic and linear terms, the equation must be of the general form (x+1)^2 + (y-2)^2 . From that we get the equation
• (x+1)^2 + (y-2)^2 -5 + k = 0
• (x+1)^2 +(y-2)^2 = 5 - k
• If the radius is 3, right hand side must equal 9 (= r^2)
• Hence 5 - k = 9 and k = -4 is the only solution.

k = -4. Method used:
• All circles with radius 3 have same general form: x^2 + y^2 - 2ax - 2by + a^2 + b^2 - 9 = 0.
• From that: 2 = -2a; -4 = -2b; k = a^2+b^2 -9;
• Hence a = -1, b = 2, k = -4.
Any other fully correct solution.
k = -4. No work shown.
Method as in code 20 but with numerical error(s) only.
Method as in code 21 but with numerical error(s) only.
All other partially correct solutions.
Incorrect answer. No work shown.

k = -12 with or without work shown.
[This answer can be obtained by the misconception that point (3,3) is on the circle, hence x = 3 and y = 3 are put into the equation.]

k = 3 OR k = 9 OR k = -9 with or without work shown.
[This answer can be obtained by the miscoknception that the parameter k represents the radius or square of radius of the circle.]

k = 8 or k = 2 or k = 14 with or without work shown.
[This answer can be obtained by the misconception that -5 + k = 3 OR 5 - k = 3 OR -5 + k = 9.]
All other incorrect responses with some work shown.
Crossed-out, illegible, or impossible to interpret.

reference_items.subject: Advanced Mathematics
reference_items.stem:
The number of bacteria in a colony was growing exponentially. At 1 pm yesterday the number of bacteria was 1000 and at 3 pm yesterday it was 4000.

How many bacteria were there in the colony at 6 pm yesterday?

descriptors: 32 000. No work shown.
32 000. States explicitly that the number of bacteria doubles every hour or shows sequence (pattern) of numbers of bacteria in 1 hour intervals: 1 000, 2 000, 4 000, 8 000, 16 000, 32 000.

32 000. States that the numbers form a geometric series with common ratio r = 2 OR uses S_n = ar^(n-1) for r = 2 OR uses an exponential equation in the general form of y = A(a^k) with A = 1000, a = 2, and K = 5.
32 000. Uses an exponential equation involving e such as y = 1000 (e^(kt)), k = 0.6931, t = 5.
Other correct responses.
Answers other than 16 000 and 64 000. No work shown.
16 000 or 64 000. Exponential equation or pattern has been recognized correctly but there is a numerical error.

Examples: s_n = ar^(n-1)
y = A (a^k)

reference_items.stem:
Two mathematical models are proposed to predict the return y, in dollars, from the sale of x thousand units of an article (where 0 < x < 5). Each of these models, P and Q, is based on different marketing methods.

model P:   y = 6x − x^2
model Q:   y = 2x

For what values of x does model Q predict a greater return than model P?
